aliases: Dong Fang Chang Fan's wisdom path inheritance star thought wisdom path inheritance

summary.text: Dong Fang wisdom path inheritance is the Northern Plains wisdom path legacy left by Dong Fang Chang Fan for his successor Dong Fang Yu Liang. Demonic path Gu Immortals covet the intact inheritance while its exact location stays hidden.

claims.text: Fairy Li Shan tells Fang Yuan that northern plains’ number one wisdom path Gu Immortal Dong Fang Chang Fan died some months earlier and left an intact wisdom path inheritance for his successor Dong Fang Yu Liang, who is only a mortal and will struggle to keep a Gu Immortal inheritance. Tip-offs say Chang Fan hid it so thoroughly that even other Dong Fang tribe Gu Immortals do not know the exact place; only Yu Liang holds the key clue. Demonic path Gu Immortals already covet it and have sought temporary alliances to contend for it, while Fang Yuan weighs joining such a scheme for a complete wisdom path inheritance that would never go on sale.

In the Tai Qiu battlefield, demonic path Gu Immortals compete for a wisdom path inheritance, but Dong Fang Chang Fan has used possession, so the inheritance sits in his mind and they have little hope of taking it that way. Peacock Flying Immortal He Ruo calls old scoundrel Dong Fang’s wisdom path inheritance the number one wisdom path inheritance in Northern Plains. Pi Shui Han says he can give up even that inheritance if he can get Dong Fang Chang Fan’s possession method.

After Dong Fang Chang Fan falls, his remnant soul bargains: he will give the wisdom path inheritance, possession technique, and other information if Fang Yuan helps him into a new body under an oath. He also claims he can hide the inheritance until his soul is gone. Fang Yuan refuses the crude traps and keeps soul searching.

Fang Yuan’s third soul search yields Dong Fang Chang Fan’s wisdom path inheritance. It is connected to Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, but is not her own legacy: in ancient times a rank eight Heavenly Court star path Gu Immortal obtained some of her secrets, tried to analyze her abilities, and created this imitation. The inheritance uses star thought Gu as its foundation, enters wisdom path through star path, and refines star thought Gu with starlight Gu as the main material. It has no special strong point beyond deduction, and Dong Fang Chang Fan used it for work such as the phantom formation and phantom beast army control.

Fang Yuan rates a complete inheritance as covering attack, defense, healing, movement, investigation, and related aspects without large gaps, and compares this inheritance’s value to the blood path true inheritance of his previous life, judging it even higher than Blood Sea Ancestor’s divided true inheritances. With Wisdom Gu in Hu Immortal blessed land, he needs durable thoughts under the light of wisdom; he immediately switches a stone nest from malicious thought Gu to refining star thought Gu.

Further soul search shows the same mysterious Purple Mountain True Monarch who gave Tai Bai Yun Sheng a time path inheritance also stands behind Dong Fang Chang Fan’s wisdom path inheritance. Fang Yuan plans to use the inheritance while preparing Hu Immortal blessed land’s earthly calamity and while deducing the immortal killer move vaguely familiar face.

When Fang Yuan activates star thought Gu, star thoughts prove durable for deduction: he estimates one star thought can substitute for three to four malicious thoughts or memory thoughts, though malicious thoughts remain better for plotting and memory thoughts better for recollection.

After three days and nights of study he judges Dong Fang Chang Fan’s immortal killer move myriad star fireflies the inheritance’s strongest offensive move, converting deduction strength into attack on a foundation of star thought Gu.

The inheritance holds more than ten Immortal Gu recipes, including star thought Immortal Gu, plus past inheritors’ refinement experiences and failure findings. It also records the unorthodox immortal killer move star fog concealment, which many inheritors never used. At his peak Dong Fang Chang Fan held eight Immortal Gu and had refined less than half of the wisdom path recipes in the inheritance.

Holders.text: Dong Fang Chang Fan Fang Yuan

Location.text: Northern Plains; hidden place left for Dong Fang Yu Liang
